```artifact
Feature: User Login and Administrator Functions

  Scenario: User accesses the system with valid credentials
  Given a user with a valid login id and password
  When the user attempts to access the system
  Then the system should grant access

  Scenario Outline: Adding specialities to the system
  Given a valid administrator login
  When the administrator adds a speciality
  Then the system should update the speciality list

  Examples:
    | Speciality Id | Speciality Name | Speciality Description |
    | 1            | Cardiology      | Heart diseases           |
    | 2            | Neurology       | Brain disorders          |
    | 9999999999   | Invalid Speciality| Invalid Speciality    |

  Scenario: Administrator creates users
  Given a valid administrator login
  When the administrator creates a user
  Then the system should add the user to the user list

  Examples:
    | User Id | User Name | User Password |
    | 1       | John Doe  | johndoe123    |
    | 9999999 | Invalid User| Invalid User   |

  Scenario: Administrator maintains system files
  Given a valid administrator login
  When the administrator maintains system files
  Then the system should allow file maintenance

  Examples:
    | File Type | Action | Expected Result |
    | Control File | Set-up | Successful Set-up |
    | Appointment File | Create | Successful Creation |
    | Invoice File | View/Print | Successful View/Print |

  Scenario: Administrator sets up users and passwords
  Given a valid administrator login
  When the administrator sets up a user and password
  Then the system should allow user and password setup

  Examples:
    | User Id | User Name | User Password |
    | 1       | John Doe  | johndoe123    |
    | 9999999 | Invalid User| Invalid User   |

  Scenario: Administrator creates appointment files
  Given a valid administrator login
  When the administrator creates an appointment file
  Then the system should allow appointment file creation

  Examples:
    | Appointment Id | Appointment Date | Expected Result |
    | 1234567890 | 2023-04-01     | Successful Creation |
    | 9999999999 | Invalid Appointment| Invalid Appointment |

  Scenario: Administrator views and prints invoices
  Given a valid administrator login
  When the administrator views and prints an invoice
  Then the system should allow invoice viewing and printing

  Examples:
    | Invoice Id | Invoice Date | Expected Result |
    | 1234567890 | 2023-04-01     | Successful Viewing |
    | 9999999999 | Invalid Invoice| Invalid Invoice |

  Scenario: Administrator backs up and archives patient profiles
  Given a valid administrator login
  When the administrator backs up and archives patient profiles
  Then the system should allow patient profile backup and archiving

  Examples:
    | Patient Id | Backup Date | Expected Result |
    | 1234567890 | 2023-04-01     | Successful Backup |
    | 9999999999 | Invalid Backup| Invalid Backup |

```
